question: Can an application developer embed Doppler for a valued feature with acceptable quality/latency and a clear local advantage over a remote API?
feature: Find the relevant passage in personal text/Markdown notes from a natural-language question, showing the source for review.

assessment.technicalFeasibility: Supported by retained installed physical application evidence on the named Linux/AMD configuration.
assessment.userValue: Existing independent applications ship this feature; the Zotero plugin author reports repeated personal use. No independent user has evaluated this Doppler integration in this task.
assessment.localAdvantage: After preparation, documents/queries can stay local and search remains available without network access. A remote-dependent inference path cannot supply inference while disconnected. No remote latency, quality, or cost win is claimed.
assessment.dopplerSpecificAdvantage: Not established against Transformers.js or another local engine. This is a feature/locality case, not engine leadership or a moat.
assessment.currentFreshDelivery: Not ready: both checked-in starter model release histories reject current-time metadata verification as expired. No signature, clock, or release policy was changed.

retainedEvidence.scope: September retained runs, not fresh October GPU measurements
retainedEvidence.hardware: Linux, AMD Radeon 8060S, 122 GiB usable host RAM; not a minimum-memory claim

largerInternalCorpus.annotation: Original upgrade label is known ambiguous; original labels and result are retained.

retainedEvidence.offline: Retained browser restart with local server stopped; retained Node run with kernel-denied IPv4/IPv6 socket creation. No observed document/query requests during retained model search.

systemChromeProbe.note: External/model acquisition was deliberately blocked by the probe to avoid downloads into insufficient free storage. The induced 500 is not a measured upstream outage or runtime inference failure.

lexicalBaseline.scope: Fresh untuned BM25 versus retained model rankings on the same small frozen corpus, not a controlled timing comparison.

disk.copyFailed: ENOSPC while copying ignored local shard_00014.bin
disk.scope: This task removed only its own partial temporary copy; no user files were deleted.

fix.change: Exclude developer-local model shard caches from the installed consumer copy; the existing server already acquires those exact signed shards through shard-sources.json.
fix.verification: Frozen external consumer installation, 1886 served asset hash checks, browser startup and offline shell restart passed. No new GPU inference qualification.

nextEvidenceNeeded: Authentically renewed signed model metadata in a new deliverable, retaining historical artifacts and expiry enforcement
Physical acceptance on ordinary target hardware and the user's representative documents; measure opening as well as repeated queries
A real user completes repeated source-finding tasks and chooses to retain the feature
Matched application comparison against feasible local incumbent and an authorized remote alternative; no paid API credentials were used

externalSources.claim: Independent Obsidian app offers local Transformers.js and remote embedding providers for semantic note search; source/README inspected, not executed.
Official plugin catalog distribution is evidence of a shipped feature, not active-user retention.
Plugin author reports using local semantic PDF search for their own research for years; self-report, not an independent controlled user study.
